title: Graceful cancellation and loading contracts for icon & compact actions
creator: Nora Patel
description:
Problem: Multiple product teams reported confusing UX when short-running actions triggered by icon-only and compact buttons were still showing a full-page spinner or became unresponsive to new input. In a recent release a change to the loading spinner placement introduced a regression where icon buttons in dense lists lost their cancel affordance; users could not interrupt accidental submits and screen-readers were not informed consistently.

Goal: Define a clear design contract for ephemeral loading states on icon-only and compact surface actions that: 1) supports interruptibility (optional cancel) for actions under X seconds; 2) normalizes spinner placement and size across themes and density modes; 3) exposes consistent ARIA semantics (aria-busy, live region messages) for assistive tech; and 4) specifies token changes and migration guidance for engineers.

Scope: redesign the loading/disabled behavior for icon-only and compact buttons, add a cancel affordance pattern (visual + accessible), update token names and documentation, and propose a migration plan for affected components (ActionList, RowActions, Toasts). This ticket covers design specs, interaction diagrams, a11y text, and acceptance criteria. Implementation tasks are tracked in ENG-45822 and ENG-45888 (see dependencies).
acceptance_criteria: New design spec shows a cancel affordance for interruptible actions with a clear threshold description (<= 4s interruptible by default)
Icon and compact buttons render a lightweight inline spinner that does not alter layout; spinner color token maps correctly in dark and high-contrast themes
Component API includes optional onCancel callback and visually reveals a cancel icon when onCancel is provided
ARIA: components toggle aria-busy during the active state and emit a polite live-region message on start/stop/cancel
Regression verified: no visual jitter or hitbox shrinkage introduced in dense lists; manual QA checklist attached
Design tokens documented with migration guidance and deprecated token alias table
comments: 2026-02-25 Nora Patel: Kickoff note — synced with PM and two eng leads. Collected initial bug reports and screenshots from product teams. Created rough flows in Figma (link below).

2026-02-28 Ethan Morales: Pushed first draft of interaction specs. Trade-off: showing cancel affordance increases visual clutter in ultra-compact rows; propose an opt-in behavior with an explicit 'showCancel' prop for component consumers.

2026-03-03 Aisha Khan (Accessibility): Reviewed ARIA plan. Suggested ensuring live-region messages are debounced to avoid repeated announcements when multiple rows start simultaneously. Recommended aria-atomic on the container.

2026-03-05 Marco Li (Engineering): Noted that runtime telemetry for cancel events will be necessary for product analysis; added ENG-45888 dependency for analytics. Also flagged potential race with KV cache updates when actions are cancelled mid-request.

2026-03-09 Design review: PM requested that the default interruptible threshold be documented and configurable; agreed to 4s default with guidance to decrease for non-idempotent actions. Updated spec.

2026-03-12 Ethan Morales: Submitted implementation PR for component API and token updates. QA checklist attached in PR. Ready for design review and accessibility verification. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui-components/pull/5789
